Product Description

Brighten up your indoor spaces with the YOROXRG Set of 96Waterproof Outdoor Flameless Candles. This value set includes 96 candles in 3 sizes, each with a rubber O-ring and back cover to protect against high humidity, high temperature, and rain. Powered by 2 AA batteries (not included), these LED candles can last for approximately 50,000 hours and come with 4 remote controls for easy operation from up to 20 feet away. The remote allows you to set a timer for 2, 4, 6, or 8 hours, and choose between flicker or solid light modes. With advanced flame simulation technology, these candles emit a warm yellow/orange light, creating a cozy and romantic atmosphere. Made of premium plastic, they are safe for kids and pets, and are suitable for various occasions such as festivals, ceremonies, and indoor/outdoor events. The set includes a total of 96 pieces, with each candle measuring 2.2 inches in diameter and 4, 5, or 6 inches in height.

      These candles really just amaze me. You get 12 total -4 different sizes -3 of each size. They take 2 "AA" Batteries each and are waterproof. They have 2 remote controls for your own applications for how you want them to look and for how long you want them on for. I took the the time to submerge them in my kitchen sink for over an hour 1 of each size and guess what, NO leaks. So yes they are waterproof. These candles for outside would be great for your patio area or anywhere they would enhance the mood you want to project with their light. They would be great for restraunts and lounges inside or out. MY own opinion is they are too good for outside and I'm using mine indoors. With these candles there isn't any fear of fire soot or odor. Adjustable mood brightness with the remote control and they simply look like real candles when lit up. And no need to replace them from use like a real candle no melting wax getting all over everything, only the batteries. These candles will set the mood and last a very long time. I like them a lot and do recommend them to you for your house business inside or outside use. You will enjoy them too. Thanks for reading my review with my pictures..

    About this Item

    • ▼EXQUISITE 96 PIECES IN 3 SIZES - This value for money set of 96lovely outdoor flameless candles with 4 remote controls (D: 2.2 inches, H: 4 inches / 5 inches / 6 inches). The size is almost the same as a champagne glass or a traditional tulip glass. The real candles is slightly smaller than the picture.The amazing 10-key remote gives more choices for brightness, modes (flicker/solid light) and a specific timer.
    • ▼OUTDOOR & WATER RESISTANT - The electricc andle battery operated uses a rubber O-ring and a back cover covering the bottom of the candle, which can protect the battery area in high humidity, high temperature or even rain. Battery powered candles are covered with a waterproof resin plastic shell, which can withstand rain and sun. Perfect for indoor guide lights or outdoor light front porch lanterns.
    • ▼POWERFUL LEDS WITH TIMER - Powered by 2 x AA batteries (not included), our waterproof flameless candles can company you for about 50,000 hours. The cool remote controls all flameless candles from 20 feet away. Once set the auto timer, the candle comes on at the same time each day and stays on for either 2 /4 /6 /8 hours.
    • ▼ROMANTIC AND COZY DECOR - The flameless candle uses advanced flame simulation technology, which flickers like a burning flame and emits a very warm yellow/orange light, creating a warm and romantic atmosphere. It is a excellent choice for festival , ceremonies or other occasions, such as any festival, anniversaries, weddings, parties, bars, family dinners, birthdays, etc.
    • ▼SAFE FOR KIDS AND PETS: Made of premium plastic, these flameless candles flickering provide a safe environment for any indoor/outdoor event with no worries of fire risk, melting wax or allergic reactions to scents. So friendly to the family which has kids or pets.You can enjoy any indoor/outdoor event peacefully with your friends/family with our battery candles.

    Product Description

    Brighten up your indoor spaces with the YOROXRG Set of 96Waterproof Outdoor Flameless Candles. This value set includes 96 candles in 3 sizes, each with a rubber O-ring and back cover to protect against high humidity, high temperature, and rain. Powered by 2 AA batteries (not included), these LED candles can last for approximately 50,000 hours and come with 4 remote controls for easy operation from up to 20 feet away. The remote allows you to set a timer for 2, 4, 6, or 8 hours, and choose between flicker or solid light modes. With advanced flame simulation technology, these candles emit a warm yellow/orange light, creating a cozy and romantic atmosphere. Made of premium plastic, they are safe for kids and pets, and are suitable for various occasions such as festivals, ceremonies, and indoor/outdoor events. The set includes a total of 96 pieces, with each candle measuring 2.2 inches in diameter and 4, 5, or 6 inches in height.
